title: What are Artifacts?

body.text: Artifacts is a feature Claude uses to show long or structured results in a separate panel on the right, instead of in the normal chat.
: Markdown documents, code in any language, HTML/CSS, SVG, and React components. Claude creates an Artifact automatically when the result is long or is
content you'll likely want to reuse

example: "Write a one-page (A4) business plan for an online coffee shop focused on monthly subscriptions."

title: Working with Artifacts

body.text: When Claude creates an Artifact, you can
edit, copy, and use it right away
. There's a Copy button for the whole thing, and you can ask Claude to revise or improve an Artifact without recreating it from scratch — Claude
updates only the part you want changed
, making the workflow far smoother than copy-pasting from a normal chat.

example: "For the Artifact you made, add a 'Marketing Plan' section and make the tone more professional."

question: Where do Artifacts show results in Claude.ai?

options.text: In the normal chat as usual
In a separate panel on the right
In an email sent to the user

question: Which of these do Artifacts NOT support?
To edit an Artifact Claude already created, what should you do?

options.text: Delete the old Artifact and have Claude recreate it entirely
Tell Claude which part to change — it updates it for you
Artifacts can't be edited after they're created

question: Claude made a summary table and you want to fix a few cells. What should you do?

options.text: Tell Claude to fix just those spots — it updates the existing Artifact
Copy it out and edit by hand only

question: What kind of result are Artifacts good for?

options.text: Code, documents, or work you want to view/edit separately from the chat
